title: Tiny, cute top hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='hatGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#4a3a8a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2e1f6e'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bandGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e84393'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c0246e'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='brimGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5a4a9a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3a2a7a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='shineGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8a7acc' stop-opacity='0.7'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8a7acc' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Brim ellipse -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='34' ry='9' fill='url(#brimGrad)'/>

  <!-- Brim top highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66.5' rx='31' ry='7' fill='#6a5aaa'/>

  <!-- Hat body (cylinder) -->
  <rect x='28' y='28' width='44' height='38' rx='4' fill='url(#hatGrad)'/>

  <!-- Hat body left shade -->
  <rect x='28' y='28' width='10' height='38' rx='4' fill='#3a2a7a' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Hat body highlight streak -->
  <rect x='42' y='32' width='6' height='30' rx='3' fill='url(#shineGrad)'/>

  <!-- Hat top ellipse -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='28' rx='22' ry='6' fill='#5a4a9a'/>

  <!-- Hat top highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='27' rx='14' ry='4' fill='#7a6abb'/>

  <!-- Hat band -->
  <rect x='28' y='52' width='44' height='9' fill='url(#bandGrad)'/>

  <!-- Band left shade -->
  <rect x='28' y='52' width='8' height='9' fill='#b01858' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Band highlight -->
  <rect x='44' y='53' width='4' height='7' rx='2' fill='#f77bb5' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Bow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='7' ry='4.5' fill='#f06292'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='56' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#e84393'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='56' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#e84393'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#f77bb5'/>

  <!-- Cute sparkle on bow -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='1.2' fill='#ffd6e8'/>
</svg>
